title: Capability Binding
description: Implementation binding for a CDL capability. Separate from CDL — describes how, not what.

approval.description: ADD-393: the gate for a capability that declares policies:[human-approval] — one POST to the deployer's endpoint, after the rate limit and before the connector, with a fixed body Archstone builds. The call is refused unless the deployer's endpoint answers `allowed` for it.

consent.description: ADD-393: the gate for a capability that declares policies:[consent-required] — the same grammar as `approval`, asked first.

origins.description: Where values of an origin-bound semantic type in this capability's output may point. Implementation, not CDL: a statement about the provider's response data, checked by the response mapper. Each entry is a bare https origin (scheme, host, optional port) — the semantic pass checks the entry syntax.

pages.description: Origins a `web-page` output value may live on, e.g. https://www.example.com. A value on any other origin is withheld.

images.description: Origins an `image` output value (scalar or list item) may live on, e.g. https://img.example.com. Never shared with `pages`. A value on any other origin is withheld.

input.description: The declared, required input field carrying the id the agent presents — a `ref:` or `identifier` field. The semantic pass checks it.

ask.description: The deployer's endpoint. The method is always POST and is not authorable; the body is fixed and built by Archstone ({version, token, capabilityId, effect, principal, approvalId, input}), never from a template.

baseUrl.description: https, or http on localhost/127.0.0.1/[::1]. ${VAR} placeholders resolve from the environment.

path.description: Static: no {placeholders}. The id is never put in the URL.

headers.description: Resolved as a REST binding's headers are (${VAR}, ${caller.NAME}). Must include an Authorization header carrying a ${VAR} secret — the semantic pass refuses it otherwise.

timeoutSeconds.description: How long the one round trip may take. Default 10.
